description: Baseline: Antopolis current state. Charming building art and ant glyphs but window undersized, log area empty, monochrome.
Responsive sizing fills desktop, figlet ANTOPOLIS header, theme tokens throughout, accent borders, Colony Log with border, 4fr:1fr district ratio
Census by caste in resource bar (right-aligned), day icon in status bar, enhanced decree/danger formatting
Per-district border colours (yellow/green/cyan/magenta), 8 seed events fill Colony Log on startup
Add subtitle row with building count and per-district census. Informative but no visual score improvement.

Visual overhaul: 2-char ant glyphs, larger 4-row buildings with silhouettes, distinct terrain textures per district (industrial grit, residential burrows, plaza clean, mines ore), subtitle row with census
Ant trails (fading footprint commas show movement history), colour-coded Colony Log entries (white/yellow/red by severity)
Dotted paths between buildings (L-shaped routes connecting infrastructure), makes districts feel like real places with road networks
Shorter district labels (drop subtitle, keep counts), pipe separators in resource bar for scanability
Static terrain backgrounds (remove tick from seed), focus mode [z] to cycle single-district view. User-requested but no score change.
Static terrain (remove tick from bg seed), focus mode [z] to cycle districts, hide figlet in focus, 3fr:1fr district/log ratio for better balance, all seed events visible
Marching ants animation beside figlet header, heartbeat pulse in status bar, ant glyph in Colony Log label. Micro-details that push character to 10.
